lessons: Map: south purple r8-11 c4-8; central purple r4-8 c9-13; NE purple (A); east purple r12-14 c18-20; green r11-15 c11-15; cyan r7-9 c0-2; yellow r4-8 c17-21.
Green ripe and purple over-ripe both pay about 1; yellow ripe pays 0.5; unripe pays about 1/4. Eat green ripe and purple over-ripe.
Early green rush works: from spawn near (0,19) I reach green at ~t17-19. That gave 8-10 pts in T2 and T3, most of my score.
E also rushes green (~t18) and takes ~3; zapping it at t24 helped me get 10 of 13.
Leaving 3 apples hanging near eaten green cells gave no regrowth within ~10 steps. Rivals strip the leftovers anyway.
Rot trick works: a cell whose apple rotted regrew in ~15 steps as unripe. Letting 1-2 apples rot restarts a bare patch.
East purple is little visited: eat half its over-ripes, let the rest rot so the cells regrow; a second cycle is possible ~t85.
By t60-70 the whole map is thin: centre, south, yellow and cyan are bare; A and C circle green late.
Yellow is not worth a trip (0.5 pts, bare by t65).
E is the main stripper and zaps; do not stand in front of rivals at contested patches.
T3 score 15.5: green 8, purple over-ripe 6. The late game adds only ~5 pts.
todo: Rush green again; zap E when it arrives ~t18-24, eat the ripes, and leave 1-2 to rot to restart the patch.
After green, go to east purple and run the rot cycle there. Alternate with the green rot-regrow cells until the end.
Check whether over-ripe green pays more than ripe green (eat one Go when safe).
Time returns so I catch regrown cells when they ripen, before A/C do.

rewrite.before:
What you worked out by the end of trial 2:
  [1] Harvest selectively: leave several nearby apples hanging so emptied cells can regrow; stripping a patch bare stopped that regrowth.
  [2] Do not wait beside a bare patch. Move elsewhere, but revisit later because rotted cells can replenish on their own.
  [3] When safe, let apples ripen before eating them; avoid unripe apples when better stages are within reach.
  [4] B competed for purple apples. D took cyan and purple apples and zapped me twice; keep clear of D's beam rather than contesting nearby fruit.
  [5] A previously zapped me, so watch its facing when nearby.

What you meant to try this trial:
  [6] Find and test red apples and untested stages of known colours.
  [7] Harvest part of a patch while leaving several apples nearby, then return to check its regrowth.
  [8] Revisit depleted patches after apples rot.

Notes you have added since:
  [9] t55: t89: Southeastern purple patch is bare too, with D nearby. Check the yellow patch’s eastern edge for its last-seen apple or fruit regrown after rot; approach north of the agents. (revised t89)
